title: catha flexuosa
intro: Catha flexuosa, commonly known as the khat plant, is a flowering plant native to the Horn of Africa and the Arabian Peninsula. The khat plant has been used for centuries for its health benefits, which include reducing fatigue and stress, improving cognitive function, and providing relief from anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of Catha flexuosa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including cathinone and cathine, which are stimulant compounds that can increase alertness and energy. The bioactive constituents of Catha flexuosa, such as flavonoids and terpenoids, also contribute to its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions.
